name: statusline
description: Claude Code status line: user@host dir (git branch); model (effort), session tokens, context %; an aligned limit table whose "Claude v1 ultra" row shows the 5-hour (live payload or fresh shared cache, "5h:-" without it) and 7-day rate limits with reset times, the 7-day % estimated to 0.1 with "~" (integer plus this machine's USD since it last changed, kept inside the integer's range) and the USD-per-1% rate inside the 7d parentheses (pinnable in statusline-usd-per-pct.txt, label "pin"), then a "Fable" cell with the Fable weekly limit the CLI last fetched into ~/.claude.json ("~" with its fetch time, "?" past its reset); its · máy này (per weekday) and · máy khác rows split the 7-day % (USD of local transcript usage over the calibrated rate); a "Claude v2 pro" row right under it shows the ~/.claude-hand 5-hour/7-day % from the shared calibration cache ("?" per missing cell); its GPT row shows the newest 5-hour/weekly quota sample for the one ChatGPT account behind ~/.codex and ~/.codex-hand (rollouts of both merged) (hidden when that sample ended over 24 hours ago) and today's estimated USD, with "?" when a today cost is unknown; rows are padded by display width so no line starts with whitespace; then one "🔧 <skill> (main)" line for the skill most recently loaded by the main agent and one per recent subagent. The statusline:setup skill installs a stable shim in the Claude config dir that always runs the installed plugin version.
